approvedClaims.proposition: In SpecSmith's model estimates at 1440p High with the same Ryzen 5 7600, moving from an RTX 4060 to an RTX 5070 takes Alan Wake 2 from 43 to 65 FPS.
In SpecSmith's model estimates at 1440p High with the same Ryzen 5 7600, the same upgrade takes Valorant from 263 to 305 FPS.
SpecSmith's model weights each game by how much it leans on the GPU; it gives Alan Wake 2 far more GPU weight than Valorant.
In SpecSmith's model estimates at 1440p High with the same Ryzen 5 7600, the RTX 5070 build has the higher estimate in all 20 games.
